title: operations.release-manager output
description: Shape the release-manager writes when a release entry is ready for review.

release_id.description: Zero-padded ordinal plus ISO date plus kebab slug. Example: 001-2026-05-22-spec-0012-tier2-bootstrap.

release_note_path.description: Path of the per-release note file.

proof_refs.description: Pointers to the gate runs, workflow logs, or test reports backing the release.

canary_status.description: Canary outcome at the time the entry was recorded.
